description: Only laboratory records with a uric acid value strictly greater than 3.9 are included.

b.request: Using only Laboratory records with `UA` strictly greater than 3.9, compute for each patient the average `HGB` and the average of (`APTT` − `PT`) over those records, then return the average of the per-patient HGB averages and the average of the per-patient (APTT − PT) averages across all patients as a single unrounded row, ignoring NULL values at every step.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_aptt_pt_diff FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID)
b.raw: Using only Laboratory records with `UA` strictly greater than 3.9, compute for each patient the average `HGB` and the average of (`APTT` − `PT`) over those records, then return the average of the per-patient HGB averages and the average of the per-patient (APTT − PT) averages across all patients as a single unrounded row, ignoring NULL values at every step.

c.request: Using 3.9 as the cutoff for elevated uric acid (`UA`), take only the laboratory records with elevated uric acid. For each patient, compute the average hemoglobin (`HGB`) and the average of `APTT` minus `PT` over those records. What are the averages of these two per-patient values across all patients? Give them as a single unrounded row and ignore missing values at every step. Only laboratory records with a uric acid value strictly greater than 3.9 are included.
c.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_of_avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_of_avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID)

d.request: Consider only laboratory records with uric acid (`UA`) strictly greater than 3.9. For each patient, compute the average `HGB` and the average of (`APTT` minus `PT`) over those records, ignoring NULLs. Then return one unrounded row with the average of the per-patient HGB averages and the average of the per-patient (`APTT` − `PT`) averages across all patients.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_hgb) AS avg_hgb, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory WHERE UA > 3.9 GROUP BY ID)
